reviewer: Codex development inspection, not independent human grading
scope: Known credits regression, all current pending review reasons, and all current unsupported/contradicted claims; not exhaustive independent grading.
known_credits_error: The previous answer said three first-fall courses were required/core. The final baseline review detects contradiction with two required courses plus one elective.

observed_judge_false_positive.original_answer_unit: - One of the following: Calculus II, Probability, Statistics, or an advanced course in physics, engineering, or econometrics that is mathematically intensive
observed_judge_false_positive.inventoried_statement: Applicants must complete one of Calculus II, Probability, Statistics, or an advanced course in physics, engineering, or econometrics.
observed_judge_false_positive.judge_reason: Source 1 says the last prerequisite must be one of the listed courses, but for the physics/engineering/econometrics option it adds a required qualifier: the course must have heavy mathematical content. The claim omits that qualifier, so it is broader than the source and therefore contradicted.
observed_judge_false_positive.finding: The original answer includes the mathematically-intensive qualifier. The inventoried statement loses it; the judge then penalizes the answer instead of recognizing an extraction error.

other_cautions: Calling listed GPA requirements main is a debatable unsupported-claim judgment.
A statement that answer information comes from one source should be checked against answer/source provenance, not require a document to state that meta-claim.
Line-local citation scope can undercount citations placed after lists or in a later summary.
aggregation: Raw automatic assessments remain unchanged. Scores are LLM assessments, not corrected human labels or objective accuracy.
